name: How much does roof repair cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does roof repair cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor shingle repairs: $150-500; leak fixes: $300-1,000; flashing repair: $200-800; full section replacement: $1,000-3,000. Varies by material, size, accessibility.
